div.div:
Families (entities/): Entity (root) · Unit: Legend (Warrior placeholder), Mob (LightMob) · Structure (abstract) · Zone (abstract) · Obstacle (data-driven kinds, breakable / unbreakable, felled trees †) · Projectile + ProjectilePool
Structures: Stronghold · SpawnerTower · BuffTower · WallSegment · Gate · Turret · Camp · Cathedral Zones: CapturePoint

div.div:
• ui/ → bridge/, ui/, styles/ only; never game/, data/ or @eternalus/core
• game/views/ → core as import type only (Snapshot types) + game/engine/ port types (Renderer, Camera); views never mutate
• Match, SessionController, game/input/ → core, game/engine/, game/views/, game/input/, bridge/, data/ (never ui/)
• The composition roots' upward imports: Match → game/views/; main.tsx → ui/App.tsx (the only place game/ and ui/ meet)
• game/settings/ → core, game/input/, bridge/ (it reaches persistence through a structural port)
• bridge/ and data/ (facades and adapters) → core types only (import type) and their own folder
• game/engine/ (L1) → browser APIs and itself only; never @eternalus/core, views, input, Match, bridge/, ui/ or data/
• packages/core (L2) → itself only; never anything under apps/ (not even L1), React, Redux, DOM, Canvas or Node
• client → core only through @eternalus/core (index.ts), never a deep path

switch.text: • ui/ → bridge/, ui/, styles/ only; never game/, data/ or @eternalus/core...
